headline: Zen Technologies Doubled Q2 Revenue with Profit Margins Above 38%
summary: Zen Technologies reported 100% year-over-year revenue growth in Q2 FY27, with operating margins topping 38%.
why: Zen Technologies is an Indian defense technology provider specializing in military training simulators.
